claims.disproof_condition: 條件：下一份定期報告或說明資料寫出 PCB 化學品（沉銅、電鍍添加劑）營收轉為年減、或伺服器／資料中心相關需求轉弱；或板廠（客戶端）一手寫出改用別家化學品或自行替代。核查頻率：每季（定期報告、決算說明資料）。觸發後 48 小時：這條 claim 降 confidence，重讀電鍍化學品層讀圖的需求段與供給段。
claims.statement: Supplier-side statement (Shanghai Skychem Technology H1 2026 report): high-end PCB and advanced-packaging makers are especially cautious in choosing suppliers of electroless-copper and electroplating additives, so this high-end segment has long been held by US/European and Japanese brands; its main competitors Atotech, Dow DuPont, MacDermid Enthone, Uyemura and JCU basically dominate the high-end market. Skychem names Victory Giant, Shennan Circuits, Shengyi Electronics, Kinwong and others as main customers, and its H1 2026 revenue rose 43.74% on market expansion and larger orders from main customers. Self-reported.

claims.disproof_condition: 條件：板廠（客戶端）或第三方一手寫出高多層板的電鍍化學品用量或規格要求沒有隨層數提高、或 18 層以上板增速轉為低於行業。核查頻率：每半年（天承定期報告）＋每季（板廠法說）。觸發後 48 小時：這條 claim 降 confidence，重讀電鍍化學品層讀圖的需求段。
claims.statement: Supplier-side statement (Shanghai Skychem Technology H1 2026 report): growth of 18-layer-and-above multilayer boards and HDI is clearly above the PCB industry on AI compute and other demand, and higher through-hole aspect ratios in high-layer designs raise the throwing-power requirement on plating chemistry. Self-reported; no customer volume figures.
